trust_decision.summary: After a successful handshake the client must not keep the PLAIN/AMQPLAIN secret in memory or render it through default fmt formatting: the decision is taken in the auth types (redacting String methods) and in the connection handshake/recovery (zero c.Config.SASL passwords in openComplete, re-derive them from the stored URL on Reconnect).

landing_point.why: The summary names 'Exported PLAIN Authentication Struct Fields', so an engineer opens PlainAuth, sees the exported Password at auth.go:23 rendered verbatim by Response() at auth.go:33, and adds a String() redaction there first.

fix_sites.entry_point: URI.PlainAuth() (uri.go:179) and Config.SASL consumed by DialConfig
DialConfig (connection.go:227) - inline SASL population replaced by setSASL call
Dial (187), DialTLS (198), DialConfig (227), Open (341) all reach openComplete

O3_reason_to_dismiss: URI.String() is the documented canonical round-trip serializer - uri_test.go:321 and uri_test.go:438 assert ParseURI(s).String() == s, so it must re-emit the password (uri.go:207); the advisory is about the SASL auth structs, not the URI type, which looks like a different concern entirely.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Caller-supplied mechanisms must survive. DialTLS_ExternalAuth (connection.go:214-219) and any user Authentication are passed as Config.SASL; a fix that re-derives SASL from the URL (as the published fix does in Reconnect, fix.diff:178-188) silently downgrades EXTERNAL/custom auth to PLAIN on reconnect. Likewise the zeroing mutates the caller's own *PlainAuth through the shared pointer in Config.SASL (pickSASLMechanism returns the caller's value, auth.go:71-81), so reusing one auth object for a second dial now sends an empty password - the upstream fix had to replace its shared package-level fixtures with fresh instances for exactly this reason (client_test.go:31-52, fix.diff:78-99).

O6_input_shapes: PlainAuth value vs *PlainAuth pointer (a value-receiver String covers both)
AMQPlainAuth - a second struct type with the same exported Password field
SASL derived from the URI (?auth_mechanism=plain|amqplain|external, repeatable) vs caller-supplied Config.SASL
more than one mechanism in one Config.SASL slice
fmt verbs %v/%+v/%s (all routed through String()); %#v and direct field access stay unredacted

O8_uncovered_routes.route: openStart rewrites c.Config.SASL to only the negotiated mechanism (connection.go:1172) before openComplete iterates it, so credentials of the other configured mechanisms are never zeroed
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Config.SASL is documented as carrying 'the successful mechanism used on the Connection object' (connection.go:44-46), so the entries openStart dropped are not the connection's retained state
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, same file, ~100 lines above openComplete; 0 packages

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A failed handshake never reaches openComplete, and Open/DialConfig still return the Connection, whose Config.SASL (connection.go:1172) holds the plaintext password
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the connection is unusable after ErrCredentials/ErrSASL and credentials must be kept for retry, so nothing needs clearing

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Connection.url stores the full AMQP URL, password included, whenever recovery is enabled (connection.go:329), and unexported fields are printed by %+v of a *Connection (a pattern the library's own tests use: client_test.go:363)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the URL is required to re-authenticate after a reconnect and is an unexported field, so it is not part of the public credential surface

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth SASL mechanism type (e.g. a token/OAuth credential struct) next to PlainAuth/AMQPlainAuth
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the package already ships three mechanisms and Config.SASL is a pluggable []Authentication, so adding a credential-bearing mechanism is the natural next commit - and a concrete-type switch in the zeroing loop would miss it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Config.Clone()/deep-copy of Config.SASL next to the existing ReconnectionConfig.Clone
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Clone is already the house pattern for config copies; a shallow copy shares the *PlainAuth pointer (zeroing one connection empties the other) while a deep copy duplicates the secret

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another Dial* wrapper that pre-sets Config.SASL (e.g. a DialTLS_OAuth alongside DialTLS_ExternalAuth)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this file already contains a wrapper that bypasses URI-derived credentials, and the fix's Reconnect reset discards any such pre-set mechanism

O9_family: cleartext storage of sensitive information in memory / credential exposure through default formatting (CWE-316)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.20 (go.mod:3); one test-only dependency, go.uber.org/goleak v1.3.0 (go.mod:5, go.sum:4-5); no vendor dir
O10_build.project_tests: Broker-free unit suite exercises this area: auth_test.go:5 TestPlainAuth (Response() encoding), client_test.go:367 TestOpenAMQPlainAuth and client_test.go:352 TestOpenFailedSASLUnsupportedMechanisms drive a full handshake against an in-process io.Pipe fake server (client_test.go:66-76, fake mechanisms at client_test.go:187-198), connection_unit_test.go:12 has no SASL test at the pinned commit, uri_test.go:247/314/417 cover URI round-trip. All broker tests are behind -tags integration (connection_test.go:6, integration_test.go:6, recovery_test.go:4) and Makefile:23-25 starts them with Docker.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a String() method to PlainAuth only (the struct the report names) and zero its Password where the URI is parsed, leaving AMQPlainAuth, the openComplete/reconnect state and caller-supplied mechanisms untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: internal/utils/http.go:26 and internal/utils/http.go:54 hardcode guest:guest credentials for the RabbitMQ management-API helper (integration build tag only) - unrelated to this advisory, not pursued.

j_defence_ineffective=1 rests on the only pre-existing guard found - URI.String() omits the password only when it equals the default (uri.go:203-209) - which does nothing for any real password; I found no other defence against the reported exposure at the pinned commit.
O1 counts Dial/DialTLS/DialConfig/Open; DialTLS_ExternalAuth also reaches openComplete but carries no password (ExternalAuth, auth.go:58-68).

Task-fairness caveat: the published fix's own Reconnect reset (fix.diff:178-188) appears to discard caller-supplied SASL (DialTLS_ExternalAuth + Recovery re-authenticates as PLAIN), so a hidden test asserting mechanism preservation would fail the published fix itself.
Whether the multi-mechanism truncation route (connection.go:1172) would be counted as in scope by the benchmark authors could not be checked.
